run_laser_scorer: run the LASER scorer to compute sentence-level similarity between hypotheses and references
create_laser_scorer: create a LASER scorer instance registered under the 'laser' scorer name in VizSeq
test_laser_score: test the LaserScorer.score method with hypothesis and reference sentence lists
summarize_laser_corpus: summarize corpus-level LASER scores by averaging sentence-level similarity scores
review_laser_group_scores: review group-level LASER scores grouped by tags for segmented evaluation
